Founding Full-Stack Engineer

Engineering

You'll be one of three founding engineers. Expect to make foundational architecture decisions, write production code across the stack, and shape how the whole product hangs together. Design and build the workflow orchestration layer: how a claim moves through states, when actions fire, how human approvals gate progress, and how it all stays auditable. Build the services behind the approve / deny / kick-off experience—the queues, the state machine, and the APIs the portal runs on. Integrate with Attune's voice and agentic APIs to launch and track payor and member calls as first-class workflow actions. Make reliability and observability a feature, not an afterthought—retries, idempotency, and clear audit trails in a domain where correctness is money. Partner closely with the product lead and the other founding engineers; move fast without leaving a mess.

Senior DevOps Engineer

DevOps

We’re looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to design, build, and scale the infrastructure that powers Attune’s platform. You will play a key role in ensuring our systems are reliable, secure, and efficient, while enabling engineering teams to ship quickly and confidently. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in cloud-native environments, enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, and is motivated by building the foundation for high-trust, high-availability software in healthcare. You’ll partner closely with engineering to improve deployment workflows, strengthen observability, and mature our infrastructure and platform practices over time.
